proposed_comments.body:
### Run the recent-placement migration when settings load

**Severity:** `medium`

This PR hides the `BeforePinned` choices, but existing settings files can still contain that enum value. Normalize the loaded model before saving migrations so upgraded users are moved to `AfterPinned` instead of keeping the disabled recent-first behavior.

```suggestion
        var normalizedSettings = _settings.NormalizePinnedCommands();
        normalizedSettings = normalizedSettings.NormalizeRecentCommandsPlacement();
```

proposed_comments.title: Normalize persisted BeforePinned placements

confidence.rationale: System.Text.Json preserves the persisted enum value, and both affected settings are consumed after load. Mapping only the deprecated BeforePinned value preserves the existing Hidden and AfterPinned meanings.

proposed_comments.title: Cover the persisted SettingsService migration path

confidence.rationale: The regression constructs SettingsService from a persistence mock that returns BeforePinned values, then verifies both exposed settings and the saved model use AfterPinned.
